desc: Write code to read N, S, and T.
Build the mapping from characters in S to characters in T. Check for consistency (same S char always maps to same T char). If invalid, print -1.
Identify the set of characters present in S.
Decompose the mapping into disjoint cycles among the characters present in S.
Calculate the total number of operations as the number of distinct characters in S that change (sum of cycle lengths + non-cycle edges).
Check if there is any lowercase English letter not present in S. If yes, subtract 1 from the total operations if there is at least one cycle.
